target.title: fix(agent): check updateSessionEntry return value for pendingFinalDelivery write
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `pendingFinalDelivery` state written via `updateSessionEntry` silently discards write failures. If the store write fails (IO error, disk full, permission denied), the delivery state is lost and restart recovery reads stale state — the reply is never re-sent.

## Why This Change Was Made

`updateSessionEntry` return value was unchecked. This call site differs from other unchecked calls in the same file (lines 1256, 1777, 1895) because those update `activeSessionEntry` in memory before writing — this one does not. The fix adds a null-check and emits a console warning when the write fails. No change to control flow on success.

## User Impact

None in normal operation. On store write failure, a warning is now visible in the gateway log instead of silent data loss on restart.

## Evidence

- **Real environment tested**: Linux, Node 22, `fix/check-pending-delivery-write`
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch**:

  ```console
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/pending-final-delivery.test.ts
  ```

- **Evidence after fix**:

  ```console
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  4 passed (4)
  ```

- **Observed result after fix**: All existing tests pass. The new `console.warn` branch is unreachable in normal operation — it only fires on IO failure.
- **What was not tested**: IO failure injection (no existing test harness for store write errors in these tests).

## Regression Test Plan

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/pending-final-delivery.test.ts
```

---

AI-assisted.
